overview: This enum labels what each end-credit line represents in the credit data.

None.simple: No credit content category is assigned.
None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_Credit uses this value as its constructor default. No exported credit row uses it and no C++ reader of the field was identified.

Title.simple: A credit line that acts as a title or heading.
Title.technical: Exported rows carry the game title, the story credit and team headings such as Voice Talent. The category is stored in the ContentType byte with no traced reader that changes layout from it.

Company.simple: A credit line naming a company.
Company.technical: Exported rows hold studio, publisher and service company names. No traced consumer reads this category to select a format.

Section.simple: A credit line that names a group of contributors.
Section.technical: Exported rows hold headings such as CORE GAME TEAM, EXECUTIVE TEAM and PRODUCTION. The field is stored as a uint8 byte on the credit row.

Job.simple: The label side of a paired credit entry, such as a character or role.
Job.technical: Exported Job rows hold character names and use Right justification with FontSize -1, LineHeightPercentage 1.01 and LetterSpacing -100. No C++ reader ties those style values to this category.

Name.simple: A credit line naming a contributor.
Name.technical: Exported Name rows hold voice actor and staff names, usually paired with a Job row. Their justification is Left or Center in the export.

Image.simple: A label reserved for credit images.
Image.technical: The enum declares this category. No exported credit row uses it and no consumer reads it. Any visual behavior for it remains unproven.

Space.simple: A blank line that adds vertical space in the credits.
Space.technical: Every exported Space row has an empty Text value. The category is stored alongside Text on the same row, with no traced reader that applies the spacing.

Invalid.simple: This value marks an invalid credit content category.
Invalid.technical: The enum declares it with value 255. No exported credit row uses it and no consumer was traced, so its runtime effect is unknown.

notes: No C++ reader of FGameDataTableRow_Credit::ContentType was identified. The row field and constructor are the only source uses besides the enum header.
UGameCreditWidget::SetCreditType takes an int32 that selects the default, short, first-DLC or second-DLC panel. This is a separate credit-variant selector.
Export counts are Title 20, Company 19, Section 52, Job 616, Name 1225 and Space 617. Image, None and Invalid do not occur.
Job rows use Right justification and LetterSpacing -100 in the export. Name rows use Left or Center justification.
The IsMain, IsShort, IsDlc1 and IsDlc2 booleans are separate row flags with no traced reader.
